code_audit.harness_solved_field: harness/src/harness/solving/agents/script_agent.py, result_for: usable = answer is not None and answer_kind in {done, value}; this is what solutions.json calls solved
code_audit.evaluator_runs_after_harness: evaluation/common/suite.py runs evaluate_suite after run_harness returns; the harness never calls evaluation.answer_evaluator
code_audit.evaluator_does_not_trust_solved: evaluation/answer_evaluator/evaluator.py docstring: solved in solutions.json only means an answer was submitted
code_audit.regulation_no_feedback: challenge_info/problem_statement.md: final set is hidden until the run, the run is one pass within one hour, and hidden tests grade the submitted answer.txt after the run
code_audit.regulation_local_neural_models_forbidden: challenge_info/problem_statement.md: local neural models are forbidden; only four proxy models may be called; classical regression/boosting are allowed
code_audit.conclusion: During a run there is no ground-truth correctness label.  Only answer-present and execution signals are available.  Retraining a classical model is allowed, but it needs labels; fine-tuning an LLM is forbidden.

domain_shift.note: transfer = trained on the 32-task research set; static = shipped OOF model; adapted = refitted in-sample on the 100-task run's true labels (oracle, unavailable in a real run).

oracle_retraining.note: In-sample fit on 100 labelled tasks is an upper bound; a real run has no labels at all.
